_doc: Boss batch B2-birds (Sonnet generic pass): family corrections only; colour/lift/snd left to builder defaults.

great-hawk/f:b0.note: pluck = beak grab; keyword-style bite for the beak

great-hawk/f:b1.note: stoop = dive that lands point-first; avoids four slashes

great-hawk/f:u1.note: talon grip that trips = snared prey; best guess vs slash

great-hawk/f:x0.note: silent circling, no tag/keyword; best guess

great-hawk/f:u3.note: a shadow passing quickly is a soft air puff; electric shock does not fit a hawk

snow-owl-monarch/f:b1.note: silent stoop = point-first dive; differs from Hush Beak bite and Talons slash

snow-owl-monarch/f:u0.note: frost wing that trips = ice glints; best guess vs slash

snow-owl-monarch/f:u3.note: silent glide of soft feathers; keeps shield for Hush Veil

snow-owl-monarch/f:x0.note: no tag/keyword; a plan spreading out quietly, best guess

frost-owl-regent/f:x1.note: thin silver crown strike glints; art line crown

frost-owl-regent/f:u0.note: rime talon stab; frost is not electric, quick tag stays mechanical

frost-owl-regent/f:u3.note: feint = a ripple of unease; not electric

frost-owl-regent/f:x0.note: a royal decree as a ward; no tag/keyword, best guess

storm-eagle/f:u0.note: thunder dive lands point-first; keeps shock for Lightning Claw

storm-eagle/f:b3.note: updraft = rising air waves; keeps puff for Gale Wing

storm-eagle/f:x0.note: gust of wind; no tag/keyword, best guess
